metaDescription: Medicine Lake, MT sits near the eastern Sheridan County line, closer to the Bakken's real activity than most of the county. I buy interests here directly.
heroLead: Medicine Lake sits close enough to the eastern county line that its mineral picture tends to look a little more active than the Sheridan County average.
intro: Of the smaller towns in Sheridan County, Medicine Lake sits nearer the stronger part of the Bakken's western extension than most, which means the interests I run into here are more likely to carry an active or recently active lease than parcels further west toward Redstone or Reserve. I still won't inflate what that means — this is edge-of-play acreage, thinner and more selectively developed than the North Dakota core, and I price it against actual production, not against the county's reputation.

I've seen families here surprised in both directions — some assume too little because they're not right on the state line, others assume too much because a neighbor's well did well. I try to correct both assumptions with the actual record.

sections.heading: What sets Medicine Lake apart within the county
paragraphs: Proximity to the eastern county line matters here. Operators extending the play west out of North Dakota reached this part of Sheridan County before they reached ground further west, so the lease and production history around Medicine Lake tends to be a bit deeper than the county average, though still modest by core-play standards.

sections.heading: Confirming your specific interest
paragraphs: I pull the recorded chain from the Sheridan County Clerk and Recorder in Plentywood, check lease status, and look at nearby well decline before discussing value. Being near a more active pocket of the county doesn't guarantee your specific parcel is under lease — I verify rather than assume.

faqs.question: Is Medicine Lake more active than the rest of Sheridan County?
faqs.answer: Somewhat, given its proximity to the eastern county line, but still thinner than North Dakota core Bakken acreage. I check your specific parcel before quoting.

faqs.question: How do I know if my family's interest near Medicine Lake is currently leased?
faqs.answer: I check the recorded lease of record through the Sheridan County Clerk and Recorder in Plentywood as part of my standard review.

faqs.question: Does being near the county line make my interest worth more automatically?
faqs.answer: It's a positive factor, but not a guarantee. I confirm actual production and lease status on your specific tract before making an offer.

faqs.question: My neighbor's well did well — does that mean mine will too?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. Well performance varies even within the same section. I evaluate your specific tract's own record rather than a neighbor's outcome.
